riwi_knowledge_sources_scope_consistency.name: riwi_knowledge_sources_scope_consistency_check
riwi_knowledge_sources_scope_consistency.value:
(
    ("riwi_knowledge_sources"."scope" = 'global' and "riwi_knowledge_sources"."scope_role" is null and "riwi_knowledge_sources"."scope_user_id" is null) or
    ("riwi_knowledge_sources"."scope" = 'role' and "riwi_knowledge_sources"."scope_role" is not null and "riwi_knowledge_sources"."scope_user_id" is null) or
    ("riwi_knowledge_sources"."scope" = 'user' and "riwi_knowledge_sources"."scope_role" is null and "riwi_knowledge_sources"."scope_user_id" is not null)
  )

riwi_learning_signals_scope_target_check.value:
(

  )

riwi_usage_metrics_tokens_check.name: riwi_usage_metrics_tokens_check
riwi_usage_metrics_tokens_check.value: ("riwi_usage_metrics"."input_tokens" is null or "riwi_usage_metrics"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("riwi_usage_metrics"."output_tokens" is null or "riwi_usage_metrics"."output_tokens" >= 0)
